description: Fetch the status/results of a file analysis started by analyze_file (use the uploadId it returned). Returns the full results object once status is "ready".

fileSessionId.description: File session the analysis belongs to. When provided and the analysis is ready, the structured summary is persisted onto that file session (same as analyze_file does on completion).

waitSeconds.description: How long to wait for completion before returning the current status (default 30).

name: get_file_analysis
